summary: Contestants design a logo, tagline, and brand identity for a fictional esports team, creating a cohesive theme across a branding document, team logo, jersey design, and promotional poster. All materials must be original, appeal to teen gamers, and follow provided guidelines. Contestants present their work to judges and answer questions.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes for setup
No more than six (6) minutes for the presentation
No more than five (5) minutes for judges’ questions
Presentation will be stopped at six (6) minutes
submission_requirements: Only contestant-prepared graphics may be used in the design
It is recommended designs be at least 300 dpi
Materials must follow the organization’s BPA Graphic Standards and make proper use of the BPA logo and/or organization’s name
Contestant ID is required for all submissions
The contestant is responsible for securing a signed BPA Release Form(s) from any person, including oneself, whose image or work is used in the project
The contestant is responsible for citing all sources, including oneself, on the Works Cited page for any work used on the project
Entries that do not follow the provided topic or the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy will be disqualified
deadlines: Submit the URL to https://upload.bpa.org no later than 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on April 1, 2027
National Deadline: April 1, 2027, 11:59 p.m Eastern Time
what_to_bring: Students may use one single-sided laptop, notebook, or tablet for their presentation
competencies: Apply foundational graphic design principles —including layout, composition, color theory, typography, and visual hierarchy—to create cohesive, accessible, and visually compelling designs for print and digital media

Develop, articulate, and present creative concepts and original artwork that visually communicate themes, messages, and brand identity to clients and stakeholders using professional communication, and digital presentation tools
Utilize technical skills and industry-standard software to edit, manipulate, and optimize graphics, artwork, and images for diverse design applications, ensuring quality and efficiency

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.

The following items have been saved as PDFs and bundled together in a single ZIP file. 1. One-Page Branding Document 2. Team Logo Design 3. Esports Team Jersey Design 4. Promotional Poster 5. Works Cited 6. BPA Release Form 7. AI Usage & Documentation Form

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
Carry-in and setup of equipment must be done solely by the contestant within the time allotted
No Internet access will be provided on-site at NLC; however, contestants may provide their own access to be used only for their presentation to the judges
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this judged event
Contestants must be registered for the national competition before the submission deadline and compete in both parts of the event to be ranked
Entries that do not follow the provided topic or the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy will be disqualified
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
